name: Kettlebell Floor Press
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, holding two kettlebells resting against the backs of your forearms with straight wrists.
Set your shoulder blades flat on the floor and position your upper arms at roughly 45 degrees from your torso.
Press both kettlebells smoothly straight up over your chest until your arms extend fully.
Lower both weights slowly until the backs of your upper arms touch the floor lightly, pause briefly, and press again.
tips: Keep your wrists neutral and knuckles pointed toward the ceiling so the bells rest comfortably on your forearms.
Pause lightly on the floor without bouncing your elbows upward into the next repetition.
